It cites no data, analysis, or source for either claim.","evidence_quote":"Late deliveries are the single biggest reason customers churn, and fixing them would save the business millions every year.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Cite the churn attribution analysis and the savings model, or remove or soften the claims."},{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"Customer phone contact without privacy review","detail":"Agents will call customers, which uses customer contact details. The proposal records none; it lists only contact center staffing.","evidence_quote":"Operations agents phone customers whose orders are running late to explain the delay and offer a reschedule.","citations":["policy-compliance#customer-location-and-personal-data"],"recommendation":"Complete and record a Privacy review (purpose limitation, retention, and how agents access and use customer phone numbers) before launch."}]}
